annotations.text:
A · MASALA MARKET
Warm editorial. The app is a magazine you can eat from: guides, opinions, a voice. Cream paper, chilli red, serif display.

Best if: trust and taste-making win people over.
Tradeoff: someone has to write the guides, every week.

B · TIFFIN
Utility first. Map, filters, open-now, distance, route, book. Bright, plain, fast — closest to a tool people open while already hungry.

Best if: growth comes from usefulness, not content.
Tradeoff: least distinctive; competes with Google Maps head-on.

C · THALI NIGHTS
A club, not a directory. Dark, loud, event-led: supper clubs, Diwali nights, a members' board where people ask who has fresh methi.

Best if: community is the moat.
Tradeoff: needs a live community on day one, or it looks empty.
All six marks are flat single-colour vectors and are shown at 44 px — the size they live at as the installed app icon on a home screen.
